caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent vessel made of greenish glass. The vessel has a wide, slightly outward-flaring rim, a swollen, rounded body, and a narrow base that flares out into a foot adorned with subtle ridges. Three evenly spaced decorative glass loops, which extend from the upper side of the bowl and curve downward in an arc, are attached to the vessel's body; each loop terminates in a rounded knob at the attachment points. The vessel stands alone against a plain beige background, with no other objects present. Near the bottom of the image, there is a simple black horizontal scale marked from 0 to 3 and a small handwritten name, "John Tragasztro." The drawing is rendered with careful shading to suggest the transparency and reflective quality of the glass.
title: Bowl
